questions.scenario_zh: 周五傍晚刚下班，最想做的是？
questions.scenario_en: It's Friday at 6pm, you just finished work — what do you most want to do?
options_zh: 按自己的保养流程来：理疗、拉伸、早睡，明天还有安排
回家和家人闹作一团，做饭、游戏、大笑，简单快乐
一个人待着，把最近着迷的那件事继续钻研到深夜
options_en: Run your maintenance routine: treatment, stretching, early bed — tomorrow is planned
Go home and get loud with family — cooking, games, laughter, simple joy
Be alone and keep drilling into the thing you're currently obsessed with, deep into the night

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友凌晨两点哭着打电话来，说刚被分手。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your closest friend calls you at 2am, crying — they just got dumped. What's your first move?
options_zh: 开着视频一直陪他，插科打诨，先把他逗笑再说
听完直接说实话：问题出在哪、他自己哪里也有责任、接下来该怎么办
安静听完不评价，第二天默默把能帮上的事都安排好
options_en: Stay on video with them, clowning around until you get that first laugh out
Hear them out then give it straight: what went wrong, their part in it, and what to do next
Listen quietly without judging, then by morning have quietly arranged everything that could help

questions.scenario_zh: 会议上你的方案被领导当众说"逻辑不通"，你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: In a meeting, your boss publicly says your proposal 'doesn't make logical sense.' Your reaction?
options_zh: 会上滴水不漏地说"收到"，会后单独找他把误会一层层捋清，顺便把关系处得更近
当场怼回去：具体哪一条不通？我现在就一条条讲给你听
自嘲一句把大家逗笑，会后该改就改，心情完全不受影响
options_en: Accept it smoothly in the room — manage the optics first, then quietly sort both the fix and the relationship offline
Push back right there: which point exactly? I'll walk you through them one by one, right now
Crack a self-deprecating joke and get the room laughing — fix what needs fixing after, mood untouched

questions.scenario_zh: 你突然收到一笔 5 万块的意外奖金，第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: An unexpected bonus drops into your account. What's your gut move?
options_zh: 投进自己的事业版图，钱要用来生钱、放大影响力
先给家人花，看着他们开心，剩下的存起来
没什么特别想买的，随手存起来，日子照旧
options_en: Put it into your ventures — money should make money and grow your reach
Spend on family first, enjoy watching them happy, save the rest
Nothing you particularly want — tuck it away and carry on as usual

questions.scenario_zh: 第一次约会，你倾向于怎么安排？
questions.scenario_en: First date — how do you want to set it up?
options_zh: 安排得明明白白，每个环节都体面周到，不出任何差错
走轻松搞笑路线，让对方从头到尾笑个不停
低调随意，吃顿简单的，能不能聊得来最重要
options_en: Fully organized — every step gracious and thought through, nothing left to chance
Keep it light and funny — they should be laughing from start to finish
Low-key and casual — a simple meal; whether the conversation flows is what matters

questions.scenario_zh: 室友把你冰箱里准备明天招待客人的食材提前吃掉了。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your roommate ate the food you were saving in the fridge for tomorrow's guests. Your reaction?
options_zh: 当面直说：这不行，今晚就得补回来，下不为例
笑着损他两句，一起点个外卖就把这页翻过去
不动声色地定好新规矩，保证这种事不会再发生第二次
options_en: Tell them straight to their face: not okay, replace it tonight, never again
Roast them a little, order delivery together, and let it go
Without drama, set a new house rule that makes sure this never happens twice

questions.scenario_zh: 派对上你被介绍给一个看起来很有趣的陌生人，你的开场是？
questions.scenario_en: At a party, you get introduced to someone who looks interesting. Your opener?
options_zh: 大方主导话题，几分钟内让对方进入你的节奏
慢半拍地接一句冷幽默，把对方逗笑还一脸无辜
话不多，除非聊到自己真正热爱的领域，才会滔滔不绝
options_en: Take the lead graciously — within minutes they're on your wavelength
Land one deadpan line half a beat late, cracking them up while looking innocent
Say little — until the topic hits what you truly love, and then you can't stop

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友突然出大事，半夜来找你帮忙。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your best friend hits a sudden crisis and shows up at your door at midnight. First move?
options_zh: 立刻启动人脉和资源：找人、出钱、定方案，今晚全部安排到位
整晚陪着他，插科打诨也好沉默也好，人在比什么都强
听完直接说该做什么、他自己哪里要改，天一亮就陪他去办
options_en: Mobilize contacts and resources immediately: people, money, plan — all arranged tonight
Stay with them all night — joking around or sitting in silence, being there beats everything
Hear it all, tell them straight what to do and what to own, then go handle it with them at dawn

questions.scenario_zh: 你最讨厌的人意外升职了。你心里的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Someone you can't stand just got promoted. Your first internal reaction?
options_zh: 默默记下：下次正面交锋，我会让结果说话
毫无波澜，各走各的路，我的日子不围着他转
跟家人朋友说笑两句就翻篇，好心情不留给这种事
options_en: Quietly note it down: next head-to-head, the results will do the talking
Zero ripples — separate roads; my life doesn't orbit around them
A couple of jokes with family and friends, then turn the page — good moods aren't wasted on this

questions.scenario_zh: 想象十年后的自己，你最希望的画面是？
questions.scenario_en: Picture yourself ten years from now — what's the version you most hope for?
options_zh: 建立起自己的商业版图和影响力，带着更多人一起走上来
回到家乡过安静日子，守着家人和自己的小天地
还在做自己最热爱的那件事，而且水平依然是顶尖的
options_en: Your own business empire and influence, pulling more people up along with you
Back home living quietly, close to family and your own little world
Still doing the one thing you love most — and still elite at it

questions.scenario_zh: 凌晨三点你毫无征兆地醒了，再也睡不着。你最可能做什么？
questions.scenario_en: It's 3am and you're suddenly wide awake. Most likely move?
options_zh: 既然醒了就起来干活——别人还在睡，这正是我领先的机会
睡眠是恢复的一部分，不容打折——翻个身继续睡
刷会儿手机看看大家在聊什么，手痒了还要回两条
options_en: Get up and work — everyone else is asleep, and that's exactly my head start
Recovery is non-negotiable — the body needs its sleep; roll over and drift back off
Scroll for a bit, see what everyone's saying — and probably fire back a reply or two

questions.scenario_zh: 部门年会需要有人上台表演节目，大家的目光突然都投向你。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: The office party needs someone to perform on stage, and suddenly every head turns to you. Your reaction?
options_zh: 主动接过话筒——带动全场气氛这种事，我向来最拿手
能躲就躲，这种场合真不是我的地方，把机会让给想表现的人
接，但必须按我自己的方式认真准备——要么不上，要上就让人记住
options_en: Take the mic — lifting a whole room is exactly what I do best
Dodge it if at all possible — this really isn't my scene; let someone who wants it shine
Accept, but prepare it my own way, seriously — either don't go up, or go up and be remembered
